Three ideal planar rail centroids at section radius25mm, offsets y=(25,-12.5,-12.5)mm and S=sum y^2=.0009375m2; untwisted centerline, positive1-y_i*kappa. Material phase observation refers to actual cumulative registry at every frozen checkpoint, not motor commands. The deliberately segmented per-rail serial-spring stiffness surrogate is distinct from an uninterrupted homogeneous coiled tape; no transfer of their favorable properties or common fabricated architecture is assumed.

model_provenance.execution: Original reported execution only; Capital copies code/output as data

proof_availability.classification_scope: The kinematic identity is planar, not full3D contact/material mechanics. Equal-pitch incompatibility applies only to undeformed identical rails in one-to-one registry, not all zippers. The feed-error history is a coherent discrete rest-length surrogate, not proof that real tape slip realizes it. The segmented spring model is not a constitutive law for intact ribbon with external clips; linear large-deflection rows/buckling screens are not nonlinear qualification. Source descriptions of load/fatigue are not unread-paper structural ratings. No supplied writer, real retained register, sensor or complete useful-system operation.
